name: detached-startup-refusal
description: CLI contract: a detached child refusal is shown to the caller and returns a failing status (#872).

config.command: bash -lc 'R=$(pwd); KOLLAB_DEV_HOME="$HOME"; PYTHONPATH="$R/packages/kollabor-agent/src:$R/packages/kollabor-ai/src:$R/packages/kollabor-config/src:$R/packages/kollabor-engine/src:$R/packages/kollabor-events/src:$R/packages/kollabor-plugins/src:$R/packages/kollabor-rpc/src:$R/packages/kollabor-tui/src:$R/packages/kollabor-voice/src:$R/packages/kollabor-webui/src:$R" HOME=/tmp/pr-chain-issue-872-scratch-home KOLLAB_NO_KEYRING=1 "$KOLLAB_DEV_HOME/dev/kollab/.venv/bin/python" -c "import os, sys; from kollabor import cli; cli._update_before_launch = lambda: None; os.fork = lambda: 12345; cli._wait_for_detached_child_startup = lambda *args: \"name already held\"; sys.argv = [\"kollab\", \"--detached\"]; cli.cli_main()" 2>&1; echo CLI-EXIT:$?'

steps.pattern: detached startup failed: name already held
detached startup failed: name already held
steps.description: caller sees the child's refusal reason
